chunks: Al-Bazawfari said: Ahmad ibn Hawza narrated to us from Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Nahawandi from Abdullah ibn Hammad from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who married a slave woman while having a free woman, without asking her permission. He said: 'They are separated.' I said: 'Does he have discipline/adornment?' He said: 'Yes, twelve and a half lashes, which is one-eighth of the punishment of the fornicator, and he is humble.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man marries a slave girl without his free wife's permission?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes that marrying a slave woman without the free wife's consent necessitates separation, imposing a specific disciplinary punishment of twelve and a half lashes—calculated as one-eighth of the standard *hadd* for fornication—along with the status of *saghir* (humility). This ruling highlights the distinct legal hierarchy between free and slave wives in Shia jurisprudence, where the free wife holds precedence in rights of choice and dignity. The specific fractional lash count underscores the nuanced application of *ta'zir* (discretionary punishment) in domestic legal matters.
